title: A small exx_pca_threshold stacks PCA auxiliary functions on top of explicit ABFS and OOMs
symptom: plus7-ABFS run: estimated chi0_q memory 18.7 GB/rank, free memory decays 165.9 -> 35.5 GB across ranks, then signal 9 (oom_kill) inside chi0 collect_Rs; a noABFS+pca1e-8 variant OOMs inside ABACUS LRI_CV::cal_datas, with a total expansion dimension of 2324 of which 1044 came from PCA, not the 1280 hand-added jle functions.
root_cause: exx_pca_threshold generates additional PCA auxiliary functions ON TOP OF an explicit ABFS_ORBITAL set; a tight threshold (1e-8) therefore multiplies the auxiliary space instead of replacing it.
minimal_fix: When explicit ABFS orbitals are provided, choose the PCA threshold so the two do not stack unintentionally (or disable PCA); budget chi0 memory as ~19 GB/rank times ranks and watch the per-rank free-memory ladder in logs.
validation: Memory ladder plus oom_kill delta; a run that reaches chi0 without signal 9.
avoid: Assuming 'PCA threshold tight = smaller basis'; it is the opposite when explicit ABFS coexists.

parameters.exx_pca_threshold: do not let PCA stack on explicit ABFS_ORBITAL
